notes: Two distinct findings. (1) The ABA contradiction is resolved against our own clamped run: directoryreactapi.theaba.org is open, un-captcha'd, and answers plain curl — verified on the first call. The clamped run's 'no public diplomate lookup exists' was a rung-2 guess published as a structural fact. Corrections to the other run's write-up: lookups/getProgramTypes 404s (getCertifications is correct) and StateId is a GUID not an integer — StateId:'41' returns [] silently, a wrong-key zero. (2) ABMS certificationmatters.org IS browser-only and it did open: 403 to curl, 200 to Playwright, no challenge shown or solved; in-page same-origin fetch then served all 120 lookups. NEW TRUNCATION CLASS: common-surname queries return non-zero tr.result-body-row COUNT with EMPTY row text (Michelle Lee: k=3, all ''), so a len(rows) check reads it as absence; a state-scoped retry over the 27 unmatched recovered 9, including Michelle Lee's pediatric subspecialty. Geography discipline held: Andrew Criser's ABA mailing AND ABMS board-reported address both say Morgantown WV, but his NPI practice address is Myrtle Beach SC — he stays on the practice address, and zero people were ADDED from either body's address. Neither body publishes an email or a phone, so the email and department-phone ceilings are unchanged at 120 of 120 checked. Neither body is enumerable (ABMS requires >=2 surname letters; ABA advanced caps at 1000), so no denominator sweep is possible. leadkit audit: PASS.
aba_contradiction_resolved: The OTHER skill's round-3 run was RIGHT; OUR round-3 clamped run was WRONG. directoryreactapi.theaba.org answered a plain curl with HTTP 200 and a JSON diplomate array on the first call of this run, and all four documented endpoints work (basic search, advanced search, doctorRecord/getDoctorRecords, lookups/getCertifications confirming 519 = Pediatric Anesthesiology). No browser, no CAPTCHA, no key. Our clamped run probed guessable hostnames (verify.theaba.org, portal.theaba.org, /verify/), hit 404/DNS-failure, and published 'No public diplomate lookup exists' — a rung-2 negative asserted as a property of the world. It never climbed to rung 3: theaba.org/directory -> directoryreact.theaba.org -> main.js, where the API base ships in the client code. This is a denominator error of the exact kind contact-channels.md warns about, and it cost the roster 3 of its 4 pediatric anesthesiologists.

marginal_attributable_to_browser_alone.detail: Of the 108 people whose certification block was filled, 101 were filled by BOTH bodies, 6 by ABA (plain fetch) only, and exactly 1 by ABMS only — Christopher John Samuel MD, Georgetown SC, where ABA returned 3 same-name diplomates with no state agreement and was correctly withheld. All 4 pediatric hits came from ABA first and were merely corroborated by ABMS. The +3 peds and +101 of the +102 cert blocks are attributable to PLAIN FETCHING that the clamped run failed to attempt, not to the browser.
